info.title: Forged Data API
info.description: Serves the Machine Learning on Artificially Forged Data study: results, comparisons and the interactive lab.

get.description: Liveness + the cached test summary from scripts/run_checks.py.
Dataset story + locked-test-set status (hash check, never its rows).
Seed sizes, random seeds, nested-split proof and class counts.
Real-data-only distribution of one column (for the data snapshot).
Per-arm summary for one model (metric means/stds across runs).

get.description: TRTR-full reference metrics per model + random-guess PR-AUC.
Fidelity summary (KS/TVD/chi2/correlation/coverage) + per-column.
DCR summary averaged over random seeds.

schema.title: Response Privacy Api Results Privacy Get

get.description: DCR distance histogram for one (generator, size, seed) run.
Generator training seconds by generator and seed size.

get.description: CTGAN loss curve for one run (exists only after a --refresh run).
Frozen criteria rules + the pass/fail table (computed by src/).
Shared-bin / shared-category real vs synthetic counts for a column.
Pearson matrices (real vs synthetic) + absolute difference.
PCA(2) fitted on real only, ≤ max_projection_points per side.

post.description: Profile an uploaded CSV and store it for lab runs (TTL applies).
Start a lab job; returns {job_id} immediately (202-style contract).

get.description: Poll a lab job's status, stage, progress, log and result.
Server-Sent Events stream of job snapshots until the job finishes.
Download the synthetic CSV produced by a completed job.
